conclusion: the reference protected schedule has no HI deadline miss
exact_statement: In the reference protected schedule, if every admissible HI task i and every task-local job index q in N has RT(J_{i,q}) <= D_{i,q}, then every reference HI job meets its deadline and the reference schedule contains no HI deadline miss. This corollary uses only the per-task WCRT result and reference schedule assumptions; it does not depend on concrete-prefix refinement or bad-prefix reflection.
